title: He
html_source: “He” is Mulligan. This associative leap implies that he also considers Mulligan a pretender.

anchor.prefix: reeches of silk of whiterose ivory, wonder of a day, and Lambert Simnel, with a tail of nans and sutlers, a scullion crowned. All kings' sons. Paradise of pretenders then and now.
